mapper.sql: operational_incidents.public_id AS publicId, operational_incidents.reporter_name AS reporterName, operational_incidents.description AS description, operational_incidents.created_at AS createdAt
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO operational_incidents ( public_id, store_id, reporter_name, created_by_account_id, description ) VALUES ( #{publicId}, #{storeId}, #{reporterName}, #{createdByAccountId}, #{description} )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM operational_incidents WHERE operational_incidents.store_id = #{storeId} ORDER BY operational_incidents.created_at DESC, operational_incidents.id DESC
